mechanism: Perphenazine may increase nifedipine levels through CYP3A4 inhibition and additive hypotensive/CNS depressant effects; nifedipine may potentiate perphenazine's anticholinergic and orthostatic effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and orthostatic symptoms; consider dose adjustment of nifedipine if hypotension develops; counsel patient on fall risk and position change precautions.
